title: GROUND: Reducing Hallucinations in LLM-Based Enterprise Analytics Through Governed Semantic Definitions
abstract: arXiv:2608.26157v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Natural-language analytics over enterprise data warehouses is increasingly important, but production use is limited by hallucinated metrics, invalid joins, wrong grain, unsafe data access, and unsupported explanations. Existing text-to-SQL systems often ground generation in database schemas or retrieved documentation, while enterprise reporting also requires governed business semantics: approved metrics, dimensions, join paths, filters, and row-level security. This paper introduces GROUND, Governed Retrieval Over Unified Normalized Definitions, a framework that constrains LLM-generated analytics to a governed semantic layer. GROUND supplies approved definitions, binds user intent to governed metrics and dimensions, and validates generated SQL against schema, metric, join, grain, filter, security, and cost rules before execution. translated_title: GROUND：通过受治理的语义定义减少基于LLM的企业分析中的幻觉现象
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26157v1 公告类型：新  摘要：企业数据仓库上的自然语言分析日益重要，但生产使用受到幻觉指标、无效连接、错误粒度、不安全数据访问和不支持的解析的限制。现有的文本到SQL系统通常在数据库模式或检索到的文档中接地生成，而企业报告还需要受治理的业务语义：批准的指标、维度、连接路径、过滤器和行级安全性。本文介绍了GROUND（Governed Retrieval Over Unified Normalized Definitions，统一规范化定义上的受治理检索），一个将LLM生成的分析约束到受治理语义层的框架。GROUND提供批准的语义定义，将用户意图绑定到受治理的指标和维度，并在执行前根据模式、指标、连接、粒度、过滤器、安全性和成本规则验证生成的SQL。在违规时，它会重试或放弃。在100个问题的合成企业报告基准测试中，GROUND表现优异。
tldr: GROUND框架通过引入受治理的语义层，约束LLM生成的分析，确保SQL查询符合企业批准的指标、维度及安全规则，从而有效减少企业分析中的幻觉现象。
en_tdlr: GROUND framework reduces hallucinations in enterprise analytics by constraining LLM-generated SQL to a governed semantic layer with approved metrics, dimensions, and security rules.
